name: monopoly
description: 联机大富翁（「朋友的数字据点」首模块，工程代号 monopoly）

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter "./apps/*" run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @monopoly/shared run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./apps/*" run test
scripts.play: pnpm --filter @monopoly/shared run build && pnpm --filter @monopoly/engine run play
